03What It IsOVERVIEW▶

A Claude skill that turns a stretch of one client's Facebook Messenger conversation ("since last", a date range, one day, or the whole history) into a new private chat page. It reads the chat in the Claude desktop app's built-in browser while Swami is signed in, saves every message and image to the client's private GitHub repo, files images and attachments in the client's Google Drive folder, and builds the page with the vibe-dashboard look. This page describes version 2.0.1, saved on Fri Nov 27, 2026.

It is a module of the client-desk skill, which owns setup, naming, the data contract (project.json, schema 2) and the sharing rules. Version 2 replaces the retired messenger-chat-dashboard skill and keeps its extraction steps, which were proven on the first client's run of Fri Nov 27, 2026.

Why it mattersMessenger keeps only about 20 messages in the page at a time, hides full-size photos inside encrypted chats, and has no export that fits a client file. This skill gives every client the same record: each update gets its own chat page, the tracker and hub stay current, and a "since last" mark means the next run picks up exactly where the last one stopped.
04What It DoesOVERVIEW▶
  • Project checkClones the client's repo, confirms it is private, and reads project.json. It stops if the project isn't set up, offers client-desk's Adopt steps for an older schema, and asks before running on a Paused or Closed client or one with Messenger switched off.
  • RangeWorks out the range from what Swami says: since the last mark in state/channels.json, a from-to range, one day, or a backfill of the whole history as one chat page. Times are read in the client's time zone, Eastern by default.
  • HarvestOpens the chat on facebook.com (not messenger.com), scrolls the virtualized message list 250 px at a time and collects every message by its data-message-id: sender, time, text, reply-to quote and reactions. It is read-only and never sends, reacts or marks anything.
  • ImagesTakes full-size photos out of encrypted chats as data URIs, in 200,000-character slices to fit the browser bridge, and saves them as numbered JPEGs named by sender and time. Avatars, read receipts and reply thumbnails are skipped, and no image is ever faked.
  • Chat dataWrites messages.json (every message with its exact time, topic, images, files, links and reactions) and content.json (highlights, decisions, specs, action items, open questions, captions, glossary and references) into chats/<start>--<end>/. Unconfirmed values say "Pending from" the client.
  • Drive filingFiles chat images in 03 Chat images, the client's files in 01 From the client and Swami's files in 02 From Swami, each in a dated subfolder, and records every Drive link. Large files go only to Drive. It never overwrites or trashes anything.
  • Chat pageBuilds a new private page with the kit's chat/build.py and vibe-dashboard's rules: Highlights, the Conversation as chat bubbles with inline images, a Messages table, an Images and Files gallery, then Mind Map, Glossary, References and the verbatim transcript, plus an audio overview.
  • Related pagesAdds a row, files, tasks and questions to comms/tracker.json, rebuilds and republishes the tracker and hub to their same links, and updates the launch page when the chat touched the product.
  • Mark and commitMoves the Messenger mark forward to the newest message, runs the NDA check, commits with a message that doesn't name the client, pushes, and reports the range, counts and links in a few sentences.

08Capabilities and LimitationsSCOPE▶
  • Since lastPicks up exactly after the last message of the previous run, using the saved message id, so nothing is pulled twice or missed.
  • Any rangeSince last, a from-to range, one day, or the whole history, in the client's own time zone.
  • Full imagesGets full-size photos even from end-to-end encrypted chats, and embeds them in the page.
  • One recordRepo, Drive, chat page, tracker and hub all agree after each run, and the pages keep their links.
  • Read-onlyNever sends, reacts, marks read or opens message requests on Facebook.
  • Any clientReads every value from project.json, so it works the same for every client set up by client-desk.
  • Safe retriesThe mark is committed only after every publish succeeds, so a failed run is pulled again next time.
  • Needs a browserThe harvest needs the desktop app's pane on a linked computer, or Chrome with Claude in Chrome; a plain cloud session can't read Messenger.
  • Needs sign-inSwami must be signed in to Facebook in that browser.
  • Page layoutIt reads Facebook's page structure (aria-label, data-message-id), which Facebook can change without notice.
  • Long backfillsVery long histories are slow to scroll; Facebook's Download your information export is the better source then.
  • v2 untestedThe version 2 flow (schema 2, new mark file, kit builders) has not had a real Messenger run yet; only the extraction steps were proven with the old skill.
  • Windows untestedThe Windows app and Chrome on Windows haven't been tried.
  • Messenger onlyOther channels (email, Zoom) need their own client-desk modules.
09Scheduled TasksRUNTIME▶

None. The skill runs only when Swami asks; "update all" is on request too, never scheduled. The nightly "Skills dashboard nightly refresh" repackages its zip for GitHub but never runs it.

11GotchasGOTCHAS▶
  • facebook.comOpen chats on facebook.com/messages, never messenger.com, which stops at an account picker.
  • You is SwamiIn message labels, "You" is the signed-in consultant; the other name is the client.
  • Relative timesLabels say "At 2:39 PM" for today and a weekday for this week; Claude resolves them against the capture date and the pane's time zone.
  • Virtualized listOnly about 20 messages are in the page at once, so Claude harvests while scrolling, not at the end.
  • Big imagesImage bytes come out in 200,000-character slices, 3 to 4 per call, because the device bridge caps a call near 1 MB.
  • Drive uploadsUpload from a copy under /home/claude: the project files folder rewrites JPEG bytes, so a hash taken there won't match.
  • Mark orderUpdate state/channels.json before rebuilding the tracker (it reads the mark), but commit it only after every publish succeeds.
  • New pageEvery update makes a new chat page; only "add it to the last chat page" appends to the latest one.
  • Personal detailsPhone numbers, addresses and emails in messages stay in the private repo; Claude asks before showing them on a page Swami will share.
  • On WindowsSave the chat page with Ctrl+S as Web Page, Complete for the fallback; install Chrome with one winget line in PowerShell, then reopen PowerShell.
12Other RequirementsREFERENCE▶
  • Client projectA client set up by client-desk: its own Claude project, a private repo with project.json schema 2 and Messenger switched on.
  • A computerA Mac (or a Windows 10 or 11 PC, untested) with the Claude desktop app, or Chrome with Claude in Chrome.
  • FacebookSwami signed in to Facebook in that browser, in the chat with the client.
  • ConnectorsGoogle Drive connected, and the Claude GitHub app given access to the client repo.
  • Code execution"Create and edit files" on, with network access for the voice model.
